name: csv_pipeline
spec: Create a command-line CSV data pipeline and reporting tool in Python using only the standard library. The tool reads one or more CSV files, performs data cleaning and transformation operations, computes statistical summaries, and outputs formatted reports. It should handle messy real-world data gracefully including missing values, inconsistent formatting, and type mismatches.
features: Accepts one or more CSV file paths as command-line arguments
Reads and parses CSV files handling quoted fields and commas within fields correctly
Detects and reports column data types (numeric, text, date) automatically
Handles missing or empty values by reporting their count per column
Computes summary statistics for numeric columns: count, mean, median, min, max, standard deviation
Shows the top 5 most frequent values for text columns
Supports filtering rows by a column value condition (e.g. --filter 'age>30')
Supports sorting output by a specified column with --sort flag
Can merge two CSV files on a shared key column with a --join flag
Outputs the processed result to a new CSV file with --output flag
Displays a formatted text table report to stdout by default
Handles files with inconsistent column counts gracefully with a warning
Shows an error message if an input file does not exist
